posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
Paul:
  1. Christopher and Adam haven't done their podcast.

Good question. Eventually?

As much as I'd love this to happen, I have a feeling that with the amount of stuff you guys have going on at the shop that there will always be a new product or project on the horizon with priority in the time department. I don't really see this ever being a real thing. It's the perils of becoming a bigger company. Time constraints between what you want to do and what you need to do are tough. I'm sure they would love to do it, but it's ability to climb a priority ladder seems questionable at best.
